name: the microphone-access dialog over a dimmed home screen
identifier_found: none; the dialog has body copy "Please enable microphone access in System Settings to use Voice." and buttons "Cancel" / "Open settings", no title; nothing behind the scrim is legible
initial_rationale: a titleless app dialog over a fully dimmed screen; the body copy names a permission, not a place in the app

test_cases.precondition: app open on the home screen
test_cases.action: tap the "Start a voice chat" entry and read the dialog for any title, and check whether the home screen behind stays legible
test_cases.expected_result: either the dialog carries a title / the screen behind is legible, or neither
test_cases.confirms_if: no title and nothing legible behind
test_cases.overturns_if: a title or a legible location behind the dialog
test_cases.observed_result: not run — the live home screen no longer shows the "Start a voice chat" row that opened this dialog, and reaching it by another route would mean starting voice mode, which is not permitted on these devices

deciding_evidence: carried from Phase 1 as provisional: the captured dialog has no title and the screen behind is dimmed past legibility; the live app no longer exposes the entry point (live app diverges from capture), and voice mode is out of bounds.
recommendation: give the dialog a title that says where it belongs, e.g. "Voice — microphone access", and keep the home screen behind it less heavily dimmed
